LITERACY ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Reading comprehension? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Reading comprehension as empty slogans with no facts.
   B. Use Reading comprehension to shame classmates.
   C. Apply Reading comprehension with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Copy a rumour about Reading comprehension without checking.

----
